title: January 21 anniversary coverage of 2011 anti-government protest; no new 2024 protest identified
reason: The opened Euronews Albania report covers the 13th anniversary of the 21 January 2011 protest, recounts the four 2011 deaths and quotes the prime minister’s anniversary call for justice. The body does not describe a newly assembled January 2024 crowd. This excludes that anniversary article as an event lead only; it does not establish that no other January 2024 protests occurred.
notes: S001 body read in Albanian at lines 57-74 of 144; the report is historical/anniversary coverage and mentions the prime minister’s statement, not a 2024 assembly. S002 and S003 remain search-only; broad month coverage remains incomplete.
